title: The Human Intelligence Bootstrap: Necessary, Sufficient, and Bottleneck Configurations for Open-Ended Cumulative Intelligence Across Animals
domain: comparative cognition / cultural evolution / human evolution / macroevolution
summary: A comparative, phylogenetically informed research program testing which combinations of cognition, social transmission, embodiment, life history, energy, communication, social networks, and externalized information are associated with transitions from animal social learning to open-ended cumulative intelligence, using extant taxa, dissociation cases, and hominin time slices.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided pre-run design; formal ARIS provenance to be frozen at full run
